## Pull request

### Summary

- What changed and why

### Architecture

- [ ] Boundaries in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` respected
- [ ] No new service without `docs/DECISIONS.md`

### Tests

- [ ] Unit/integration added or updated
- [ ] Playwright journey covered if UI/auth changed
- [ ] No fake-green tests

### Security

- [ ] No secrets in the diff
- [ ] RBAC considered for new endpoints/views

### Ops

- [ ] Docs updated if schema/API/behavior changed
- [ ] Migrations included if schema changed

### Merge

- [ ] `docs/QUALITY_GATES.md` satisfied
- [ ] Human approval to merge (not an agent)
- [ ] Target is `develop` unless a human names another branch; never agent-merge to `main`
- [ ] Do not delete branches as part of this PR
